title: Culayska Hantida
intro: Waxaad hor taagan tahay sheeko nasiib aad u weyn, nolol lagu qurxiyey dahab iyo awood, haddana ugu dambeyntii cashar digniin ah oo loogu talagalay dhammaan kuwa raadinaya sharafta adduunyada. Ma furi kartaa aqoonsiga qofkan sheekadiisu ay soo noqnoqonayso waqti ka dib, taasoo markhaati u ah dabeecadda sii socota ee hantida adduunyada?
clues: Waxaan ka mid ahaa dadkii Nabi weyn, laakiin waxaan doortay waddo kibir iyo dulmi ah.
Ilaahay wuxuu i siiyay hanti aad u badan, taasoo keentay in furayaasha khasnadahaygu ay culays culus ku noqdeen koox rag ah oo xooggan.
Dadkaygu waxay igula taliyeen inaan ku faanin maalkayga, iyagoo i xasuusinaya in Alle uusan jeclayn kuwa ku faanaya.
Waxaan si kibir leh u sheegay in nasiibkayga ballaaran uu ku yimid aqoontayda iyo dadaalkayga, ee uusan ahayn nimco ka timid Alle.
Waxaa la iga digay musuqmaasuqa waxaana la i xasuusiyay inaan Aakhiro ku raadiyo wixii Alle i siiyay, laakiin waan diiday inaan dhegeysto oo waan iska sii watay kibirkaygii.
Ugu dambeyntii, Alle wuxuu dhulka ku qasbay inuu i liqo aniga iyo hoygayga, isagoo iga reebay cid aan u gargaarin xukunkiisa.

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Si nabad ah ayuu u dhintay

verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
